comment: The DeepSeek Harness version line this plugin pack is built and tested against. Plugins are shipped as alpha until the owner promotes them to stable. The installer pins this exact dsh version when driving the CLI. 'vendoredFrom' records the harness line whose client bundles dsh-rightbar / dsh-rightbar-files / dsh-open-in-app were forked from. dsh-vn-master is the pack's blank master: the bundle layer alone, no browser half.
comment_platforms: The plugins are plain JavaScript and platform-neutral; the only OS-specific code is dsh-open-in-app's file-browser launcher (explorer.exe / open / xdg-open, WSL-aware). The launchers run on Windows (install.bat, PowerShell 5.1 or 7) and on macOS/Linux (install.sh, PowerShell 7+).

dsh-vn-master.role: the pack's master and deliberately blank: the bundle layer alone (installed last, so it is the final word per row); no dsh.client, no service, no inject edge, and no core-row disables - those stay with the packages that replace the rows

shadowsSlots.why: the rendered Markdown body carries the Edit toggle back into the editor (lower priority renders) and undoes what the preview's plain-text scrollport imposes on its contents (white-space:pre and the mono font stack)

dsh-gittree.role: the workspace's git tree and history as a page tab type (guide order 30, after Files and Editor); its Node half owns read-only /api/dsh-gittree routes - no fork, no core row disabled, nothing for sync-vendored.ps1 to track

overrides: markdown paper: re-declares ui-theme's light declarations on the rendered Markdown root, so the page stays white in the dark theme
markdown chrome: hides the preview header's viewer menu on Markdown tabs (the page has exactly one renderer; the editor's Edit button is the way back to editing)
